title: Ledger
description: Tally's books: who spent what, on which model, in which directory.

panels.title: Cost by model

targets.queryText: select model, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by model order by cost desc
targets.rawQueryText: select model, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by model order by cost desc

panels.description: All sessions and agents in the range.

panels.title: Cost by working directory

targets.queryText: select replace(cwd, '/home/purplg/claude', '~') as dir, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by cwd order by cost desc limit 12
targets.rawQueryText: select replace(cwd, '/home/purplg/claude', '~') as dir, sum(cost_usd) as cost from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by cwd order by cost desc limit 12

panels.description: Where Claude was started: the Manager's root, a task workspace, a tool worktree.

targets.queryText: select sum(case when agent_id is null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Manager, sum(case when agent_id is not null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Agents from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000
targets.rawQueryText: select sum(case when agent_id is null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Manager, sum(case when agent_id is not null then cost_usd else 0 end) as Agents from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000

panels.title: Most expensive sessions

targets.queryText: select substr(session_id,1,8) as session, replace(cwd,'/home/purplg/claude','~') as dir, count(*) as messages, round(sum(cost_usd),2) as cost_usd, datetime(min(ts),'unixepoch') as first, datetime(max(ts),'unixepoch') as last from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 and agent_id is null group by session_id order by sum(cost_usd) desc limit 15
targets.rawQueryText: select substr(session_id,1,8) as session, replace(cwd,'/home/purplg/claude','~') as dir, count(*) as messages, round(sum(cost_usd),2) as cost_usd, datetime(min(ts),'unixepoch') as first, datetime(max(ts),'unixepoch') as last from message_costs where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 and agent_id is null group by session_id order by sum(cost_usd) desc limit 15

panels.description: Manager-level sessions only; subagents are on the Agents dashboard.
